Name: Jammer
Overview: Jammer is a rhythm game in which each level visually represents one of ten included songs. Gameplay unfolds across up to five vertically scrolling lanes, each capable of displaying three parallel nodes, though only one node per lane is active at any given moment. Players control a device with three aligned circles that match the node layout of a lane. The device can be moved horizontally to switch lanes, and the player must press the correct button when a node aligns beneath a circle. Multiple lanes can have active nodes simultaneously, allowing for dynamic input across the field. While there is no failure condition, sustained accuracy on a single lane fills a progress bar, altering the musical output.
